description.value: Me-n-Ed's Pizza is a proudly Canadian-owned family pizza chain operating in the Lower Mainland since 1969, known for specialty and premium pizzas made with fresh ingredients. The restaurant offers dine-in alongside delivery and takeout, and pours local BC craft beers on tap. With a catering menu and a loyalty program, it's a solid stop for a hungry touring cyclist looking for a full sit-down meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Me-n-Ed's is a real, actively operating pizza chain with delivery and takeout prominently advertised, consistent with OSM tags. The corporate site does not list a North Vancouver location — only Burnaby, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Maple Ridge, and Langley — and the OSM coordinates (49.2493, -122.861) place this record in the Burnaby/Coquitlam area, not North Vancouver, which is a notable community mismatch. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Community field says 'North Vancouver' but OSM coordinates (49.2493, -122.861) place this record in the Burnaby/Coquitlam area, and the website lists no North Vancouver location. The 604-931 phone exchange is consistent with Coquitlam. The community tag appears to be incorrect.
No street address present in OSM record.
Website is the corporate homepage covering all five locations; no location-specific page was available to confirm details for this particular outlet.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant chain with confirmed online presence and delivery/takeout service; useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal stop.

wow_evidence: Canadian-owned family pizza chain operating in the Lower Mainland since 1969
